title: 365th Basic Training Class graduates from Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center
summary_en: After 14 weeks of training, members of the 365th Basic Training Class reached their goal of becoming sworn law enforcement officers. Friends and family filled Integrity Hall on Nov. 13 to celebrate the graduates and mark the occasion.
title_cn: 365th Basic Training Class graduates from Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center

title: 2026 Mini Wheat State Tour explores western Kansas innovation
summary_en: On Oct. 23-24, the Hall Center for the Humanities’ Mini Wheat State Tour brought University of Kansas faculty and staff to Colby and the surrounding area to explore the technology, innovation and community resources shaping life in the northwest corner of the state.
title_cn: 2026 Mini Wheat State Tour explores western Kansas innovation
